author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: तत्र द्विप्रकारेऽपि जन्मनि पौर्वदैहिकं पूर्वदेहे भवंतं बुद्धिसंयोगं मनोयोगं ध्यानमितियावत् ।  लभते ।  ततो भूयः पौर्वदैहिकादधिकं संसिद्धौ ध्यानसंपूर्तौ यतते यत्नं करोति हे कुरुनन्दन ॥ ६.४३ ॥
translation:
Then he obtains that mental relation (contemplation of the Lord) which he had formed in the previous life; And now he endeavours for still further accomplishment, О the delight of Kurus. (43)
V. Still further accomplishment: for greater intensity of devotion and contemplation. (43)
